import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13.5, 8.2))
ax.set_xlim(0,13.5); ax.set_ylim(0,8.2); ax.axis("off")

def box(x,y,w,h,txt,fc,ec="#333333",fs=8.6,tc="black"):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y),w,h,boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",fc=fc,ec=ec,lw=1.1))
    ax.text(x+w/2,y+h/2,txt,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=fs,color=tc,wrap=True)

def arrow(x1,y1,x2,y2,c="#444444",ls="-"):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x1,y1),(x2,y2),arrowstyle="-|>",mutation_scale=13,
                                 lw=1.3,color=c,linestyle=ls,shrinkA=2,shrinkB=2))

GEN="#d6e4f0"; MOL="#dff0d8"; CELL="#fdebd0"; TIS="#f5d0c5"; CLIN="#e8daef"

box(4.8,7.25,4.0,0.72,"1. Biallelic ATP1A2 LoF variants\n(nonsense, frameshift, splice)",GEN,fs=9.2)
box(4.8,6.25,4.0,0.72,"2. No immunodetectable alpha2\nNa+/K+-ATPase protein (brain)",GEN,fs=9.2)
arrow(6.8,7.25,6.8,6.97)
box(4.8,5.25,4.0,0.72,"3. Loss of the local Na+ gradient at\nalpha2 plasma-membrane microdomains",MOL,fs=9.2)
arrow(6.8,6.25,6.8,5.97)

# three branches
yb=4.05
box(0.3,yb,4.0,0.92,"4a. KCC2 (SLC12A5) co-transport fails\n-> neuronal [Cl-]i rises -> GABA/glycine\ndepolarising instead of inhibitory",MOL,fs=8.2)
box(4.75,yb,4.1,0.92,"4b. EAAT/GAT reuptake stalls\n-> synaptic glutamate and GABA persist\n-> c-Fos induction, neural hyperactivity",MOL,fs=8.2)
box(9.25,yb,4.0,0.92,"4c. NCX1 reverse mode in arterial\nsmooth muscle -> [Ca2+]i rises\n-> increased myogenic tone  [INFERRED]",MOL,fs=8.2)
arrow(6.4,5.25,2.3,yb+0.92); arrow(6.8,5.25,6.8,yb+0.92); arrow(7.2,5.25,11.25,yb+0.92,ls="--")

yc=2.75
box(0.3,yc,4.0,0.82,"5a. preBotzinger/brainstem rhythm\ngenerator cannot sustain bursting",CELL,fs=8.4)
box(4.75,yc,4.1,0.82,"5b. Excitotoxic apoptosis in amygdala,\npiriform cortex, basal ganglia",CELL,fs=8.4)
box(9.25,yc,4.0,0.82,"5c. Fetal cerebral hypoperfusion;\nmeningeal arterial calcification  [INFERRED]",CELL,fs=8.4)
arrow(2.3,yb,2.3,yc+0.82); arrow(6.8,yb,6.8,yc+0.82); arrow(11.25,yb,11.25,yc+0.82,ls="--")

yd=1.45
box(0.3,yd,4.0,0.82,"6a. No fetal breathing movements,\nno spontaneous limb movement",TIS,fs=8.4)
box(4.75,yd,4.1,0.82,"6b. Basal-ganglia necrosis/calcification,\npyramidal tract agenesis, dentato-olivary dysplasia",TIS,fs=7.8)
box(9.25,yd,4.0,0.82,"6c. Late-gestation laminar cortical\nnecrosis -> clastic polymicrogyria  [INFERRED]",TIS,fs=8.4)
arrow(2.3,yc,2.3,yd+0.82); arrow(6.8,yc,6.8,yd+0.82); arrow(11.25,yc,11.25,yd+0.82,ls="--")

box(2.2,0.25,9.2,0.82,"7. FARIMPD (MONDO:0859204, OMIM:619602): fetal akinesia sequence + polyhydramnios + arthrogryposis + hydrops,\nmicrocephaly, polymicrogyria, dysmorphic facies -> respiratory insufficiency at birth -> neonatal death",CLIN,fs=8.8)
arrow(2.3,yd,5.2,1.07); arrow(6.8,yd,6.8,1.07); arrow(11.25,yd,8.6,1.07,ls="--")

ax.text(0.3,7.95,"ATP1A2 FARIMPD: ordered causal chain from null allele to neonatal death",fontsize=12.5,weight="bold")
ax.text(0.3,7.62,"solid = demonstrated in human tissue or Atp1a2 mice;  dashed + [INFERRED] = inferred from autopsy plus heterozygous mouse artery data",
        fontsize=8.6,style="italic",color="#555555")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
